research_assessment.memory_hypothesis: Supported in this fixed-seed nominal one-step comparison: No-Memory GRU is close to Markov, while the parameter-matched Full-History GRU has substantially lower error.
research_assessment.full_history_extra_improvement: 49.07199% physical RMSE reduction and 58.62430% standardized RMSE reduction relative to No-Memory.
research_assessment.no_memory_vs_markov: Only 1.31978% physical and 1.27665% standardized RMSE reduction; No-Memory slightly worsens the three distance regions below 0.5m.
research_assessment.interpretation_boundary: Evidence is descriptive for one seed/split, not a universal memory-necessity theorem or causal identification of PI contents. Previous action stays as a permitted input; fixed zero hidden naturally disables temporal recurrent paths.
research_assessment.next_recommendation: A separately authorized frozen multi-step rollout evaluation is reasonable; no multi-step evaluation, model retraining or next phase was performed.

generation_config.input_convention: pre-command obs7 + previous executed normalized action4

dataset.transition_rule: o_t=inputs[t,:7], a_t=actions[t], next=inputs[t+1,:7]; within episode only
dataset.previous_action_rule: inputs[t,7:11] = executed normalized action at t-1; reset=0

trainer.loss: normalized delta MSE, valid timestep/dimension mean
trainer.sequence: whole ordered episodes, hidden=None at start, right padding masked out
trainer.selection: minimum validation MSE; no early stopping; no Test-based selection

intervention: each [o_t,previous executed normalized action] is an independent length-1 GRU lane with zero hidden; same head/current action

integral_bins.rule: Train transition PI norm tertiles; small<q1, q1<=medium<q2, large>=q2

tests.readonly_review: No blocking findings; optional checkpoint-validation verification improvement implemented and regression-tested.

limitations: Single seed and nominal one-step 25Hz prediction only; no multi-step or physical generalization.
No recurrent memory still retains previous executed action as a permitted current feature.
Full-history/no-memory parameter tensors match, but zero hidden naturally disables temporal paths, including gradients through recurrent hidden-weight matrices.
Markov vs no-memory additionally differs in input features/capacity; pure memory inference uses full-history vs no-memory.
PI-state augmented MLP is not a full MuJoCo-state prediction lower bound.
Physical overall metrics combine m,m/s,rad; consult normalized and per-dimension metrics.
